description.en: Global, cross-session todo list where a person and an agent write to the same items: each entry records when it was added, accepts attached documents and links, and can be handed to an agent session. Ships as a sidebar panel plus ten agent tools, stored as one JSON file.
description.zh: 全局待办：人与 Agent 共用同一份跨会话清单，每条记录加入时间，可挂文档与地址，并可一键交给 Agent 会话继续处理；提供侧边栏面板与十个 agent 工具，数据存为一个 JSON 文件。
